Code Implementation of a paper on Adaptive Mammographic Image Enhancement. The goal of the project was to enhance the breast mammographic images so as to ease the detection of micro-calcifications or granular masses that may be malignant.

frontmatter.title: FORID - Field Orbiting robot to Identify Disease
